memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever." – (Hebrews 13:8)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
A true standard never changes. If an item is labeled as "100 grams," it must remain 100 grams no matter where it goes. If it weighs less, it is considered substandard and rejected.
​Christ is our Master Scale—the ultimate, unchanging dimension. He has not changed, nor will He ever change, through any time, culture, or circumstance. We are called to grow to be like Him. We must grow to match His measure in love, holiness, truth, and obedience.
​If we remain lacking, that very deficiency could be the reason for rejection on Judgment Day. Yet, our Redeemer grants us boundless grace through the Holy Spirit. He is both the absolute standard and the Way who leads us to that standard.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: ​“The primary goal of God is to make man holy. His single purpose is to create a holy people.” — Oswald Chambers, (Book)My Utmost for His Highest

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, You are my standard.
My heart yearns to grow by looking unto You, not others.
Grant me the grace to be transformed through Your Holy Spirit.
Lift me up to the measure You desire.
May You be glorified on the Judgment Day. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May God grant you the grace to grow more like Christ today! May your life shine according to His glorious measure!

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: THE PURSUIT OF HOLINESS
recommended_book.author: Jerry Bridges
recommended_book.quote: ​“God does not expect us to reach His standard on our own. Rather, by His power, we must strive to grow toward that standard.”
